blocks.heading: What Is NIOS and Who Should Take It
blocks.html:
NIOS is a national board under the Ministry of Education, and its Class 10th and 12th certificates carry the same recognition as CBSE for higher education, government jobs and competitive exams.

NIOS admission in Lucknow is usually the right choice if you:

  • failed one or more subjects in CBSE, ICSE or UP Board and do not want to repeat the whole year
  • left school earlier and want to complete Class 10th or 12th now
  • are preparing for NEET, JEE or a government exam and need a lighter school schedule
  • are working, or cannot attend a regular school every day
  • want to change your subject combination, for example moving to a science stream

There is no upper age limit for Class 10th, and the minimum age is 14 years. For Class 12th the minimum age is 15 years, and you need a passed Class 10th certificate from a recognised board.

blocks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About NIOS Admission
blocks.subheading: The questions parents and students ask us most often at the Lucknow centre.

items.title: Is the NIOS certificate valid for government jobs and college admission?
items.text: Yes. NIOS is a national board recognised by the Ministry of Education, the Association of Indian Universities and the UGC. Its Class 10th and 12th certificates are accepted for college admission, government jobs and competitive exams exactly like a CBSE certificate.

items.title: What is the last date for NIOS admission in Lucknow?
items.text: Stream 1 block 1 usually closes in July and block 2 in January, while stream 2 for failed students runs from August to September. NIOS extends these dates with a late fee most years, so contact the centre before assuming you have missed the window.

items.title: How much does NIOS admission cost?
items.text: The NIOS board fee depends on your class, the number of subjects and whether any subject has a practical. Coaching, study material and TMA support are charged separately. We give you the complete breakdown in writing during counselling, before anything is paid.

items.title: Can I take NIOS admission after failing in CBSE or UP Board?
items.text: Yes, and you do not lose the subjects you already passed. Under NIOS transfer of credit you can carry forward up to two passed subjects and only appear for the rest, which is why stream 2 students often finish in a single exam cycle.

items.title: Are TMAs compulsory in NIOS?
items.text: Yes. Tutor Marked Assignments carry 20% of the marks in each subject and must be submitted to your study centre. Skipping them means you cannot pass even with a good theory paper, so we prepare and submit them for every student.

items.title: Do I have to attend classes at the centre?
items.text: No. NIOS itself does not require daily attendance, and our classes run both online and at the Lucknow centre. Practical subjects are the exception - those sessions have to be attended in person.

items.title: Can I appear for NEET or JEE with a NIOS certificate?
items.text: Yes. NTA accepts NIOS Class 12th for both NEET and JEE, provided you have taken the required subjects with practicals. Make sure Physics, Chemistry and Biology or Maths are in your combination at the time of admission.
